description: R-BUDGET baseline, measured on an IDLE CI runner. Monotone: the gate fails on a regression beyond TOLERANCE and on a WIDENED gap to the ROADMAP:276 budget. Superseded the provisional developer-machine baseline, which was inflated ~1.6x and left the ratchet loose.
pending_ci_note: OPEN-104. cold_check_ms (validators_cli --compile-check, whole process, wall clock, median per band) and the keystroke structural_ms column are MEASURED and printed on every perf-ci run but have no recorded value yet, because ADR-011 allows a baseline only from an idle CI runner and none existed when the mechanism landed. Until they are adopted the gate cannot fail on them. To record: from a green perf-ci run on main, run 'gh run download RUN_ID -n keystroke-budget-measured -D DIR', then 'python3 scripts/tools/check_keystroke_budget.py --adopt DIR/keystroke_budget_measured.json', and commit this file. --adopt refuses a file without a CI run id or measured above load 4.0, and writes only the pending metrics.
